title: Anime Character Offline Database Schema
description: Schema for the anime character database. This extends the MyAnimeList API types from @shineiichijo/marika v3, adding additional metadata and computed fields for offline use.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this schema definition

generatedAt.description: ISO time when this file was generated

name.description: Name of the data source, e.g. 'MyAnimeList API via Jikan v4'

totalCharacters.description: Total number of characters in the database

data.description: Array of character entries, each extending the ICharacterFull type from @shineiichijo/marika

items.description: Character entry that extends ICharacterFull from @shineiichijo/marika with additional fields

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp for when this entry was last refreshed

voiceActorsByLanguage.description: Optional precomputed groupings of voice actors by language. Uses IVoiceActor from @shineiichijo/marika

animeAppearances.description: Optional denormalized anime appearances for convenience. Uses IAnime from @shineiichijo/marika

VoiceActor.description: Voice actor type from @shineiichijo/marika/dist/types/anime.js (IVoiceActor). See Marika documentation for full type definition.

Anime.description: Anime type from @shineiichijo/marika/dist/types/anime.js (IAnime). See Marika documentation for full type definition.
